perks.name: Resupply
perks.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, your next final blow grants additional ammo progress and creates an Orb of Power.
perks.exact:
Scoring a kill spawns an Orb of Power that grants 1?% Super Energy, as well as +20% Special Ammo Progress and +20% Heavy Ammo Progress.
Incurs a 12 second cooldown before it can retrigger.

perks.name: From the Storm
perks.description: After being out of combat for a moderate duration, slowly gain Frost Armor until you reenter combat.
perks.exact:
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<<

After having maintained a state of not dealing or receiving damage for at least 12 seconds:
Grants a stack of Frost Armor every 3 seconds.
Stacks up to x5 Frost Armor, refreshing its duration every 3 seconds.

item.description: +10 Grenade ▲

item.name: +Grenade / -Health
item.description: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Health stat.

item.name: Grenade Font
item.description: Collecting an Orb of Power causes you to gain 1 temporary Armor Charge.
item.exact:
While Armor Charge is active:

+20 | +40 | +50 Grenade.

item.name: Firepower
item.description: Your grenade final blows create Orbs of Power.
item.exact:
On Grenade Kill:
Spawns a Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Incurs a 10 | 5 | 1 second cooldown between Orbs.
Can trigger alongside Heavy Handed if equipped before it.
From left to right order.

item.name: Focusing Strike
item.description: Grants class ability energy when you cause damage with a powered melee attack.
item.exact:
Upon dealing Powered Melee Damage:
Grants Class Ability Energy.

Ability Energy Gain:
12% | 17% | 20%
6% | 8.5% | 10%

Incurs a 7 second cooldown after activation.

item.name: Weapons Mod
item.description: +10 Weapon ▲

item.name: +Weapons / -Health
item.description: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Health stat.

item.name: Impact Induction
item.description: Causing damage with a powered melee attack reduces your grenade cooldown.
item.exact:
Upon dealing Powered Melee Damage:
Grants Grenade Ability Energy.

Ability Energy Gain:
12% | 17% | 20%
6% | 8.5% | 10%

Incurs a 7 second cooldown after activation.

item.name: Momentum Transfer
item.description: Causing damage with a grenade reduces your melee cooldown.
item.exact:
Upon dealing Grenade Damage:
Grants Melee Ability Energy.

Ability Energy Gain:
12% | 17% | 20%
6% | 8.5% | 10%

Incurs a 7 second cooldown after activation.
Does not work with Grapple.

item.description: Increases reload speed of Stasis weapons.
item.exact:
To Mod-Element Matching Weapon, after ~0.5 second of readying the weapon:

+10 | +15 | +18 Reload Speed
0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier
